business_problem: MACAU Pass needed to support rapid growth in e-wallet transactions and mCoin redemptions while lowering infrastructure costs, maintaining compliant cross-regional connectivity, and keeping payment services stable during promotional traffic spikes.
solution_summary: MACAU Pass modernized the infrastructure behind its MPay Macau Wallet and mCoin loyalty services with a broad Alibaba Cloud stack spanning application delivery, databases, analytics, and secure connectivity. Server Load Balancer fronts the payment workload and spreads traffic across Elastic Compute Service instances, while ApsaraDB RDS and ApsaraDB for Redis handle transaction persistence and low-latency data access for the wallet and loyalty flows. Object Storage Service provides durable storage, and VPN Gateway secures links back to data centers in different regions so regulated payment operations remain connected and compliant. For analytics and operational improvement, MACAU Pass uses DataWorks and Quick BI to develop, manage, and analyze data from the payment platform. The result is a cloud architecture that can absorb promotion-driven surges, improve cost-effectiveness, and give the company a path to migrate more of the payment estate onto Alibaba Cloud with stronger security and business intelligence.
business_outcome: MACAU Pass improved the cost-effectiveness and resilience of its digital-wallet platform while gaining better analytics and a more scalable base for business expansion.
